work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Independent act with literal Clement XII protocol at 62437-62438, complete numbered synopsis/opening at 62426 onward, and final dating plus repeated date at 62551-62556. References to Paul V and Urban VIII at 62471-62474 are predecessors' confirmations recounted in the petition, not independent protocols. Previous act ends at 62420; next numbered act starts at 62559. No historical footnotes occur in this act or move into it from the reviewed context. No boundary, signature, dating, or note blocker found in the reviewed OCR. Extended context through 62795 establishes that the later note at 62786 corrects the explicitly marked finiri at 62776 in the succeeding CCXLI/CCXLIII act, not this act's unmarked definiri at 62540. Source-extent re-audit: literal etc. at 62446 belongs to the marginal synopsis of the power to change/add constitutions; the body states that power in full at 62477-62483. The current confirmation and its final clauses are printed, with no substantive-body substitution. Its shortened non-obstante wording at 62545-62549 is the literal printed conventional closing clause, retained without expansion. Admission is of the complete independently bounded printed witness.
